question_as_asked: For the driver who set the fastest lap speed, what is his nationality?
executed_sql: SELECT T1.nationality FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId ORDER BY T2.fastestLapSpeed DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
